title: 第668章 只能说全靠同行衬托第667章 这家伙是狗吧
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 包厢之中。
苏业看着坐在里面的少女，眼中带着一丝异色。
柳妃！
整个帝国的全民偶像级别的存在，用娱乐圈的话来说，她不出事情，其她女明星一辈子都别想出头的那种。
就是这么离谱。
但是现在却乖乖的坐在包厢之中，精致的小脸上带着一丝抹不去的愁容，却不得不带着笑容。
往日灵动的眼神，此刻却有些灰白。
在这之前，她被照顾的很好，非常好，出道以来，就是被捧上天的那种。
直到现在。
她才清楚，不管她多出名，多有能力，但是在这些权贵的面前，也就那样。
她有人照顾不是没人看上她，而是她很贵，很值钱，公司不想她贬值，这才是她一路走来顺风顺水的缘故。
毕竟娱乐圈这个地方，懂的都懂，就特么没有几个干净的，除非是自己家里有钱有势来玩的，那是另外一回事情。
“苏先生满意吗？”傅伟脸上带着笑容的说道。
这可是金清娱乐传媒特意捧出来的存在，还很干净，不知道有多少人盯着，但是傅伟清楚。
女人最值钱就两个字：干净！！
虽然话不好听，但是事实就是如此，尤其是对于苏业这样的花花公子来说，什么没玩过。
干净才是最重要的，其她的都不重要，培养了那么久，付出了那么多，现在轮到柳妃展现出自己的价值的时候了。
“满意，很满意。”苏业笑着直接坐到了柳妃的面前。
看着面前的柳妃，精致的小脸上，带着委曲求全的笑容，眼中带着抹不去的哀伤，让人不由心生怜爱。
“柳妃小姐，我是你的粉丝啊。”苏业笑着向着柳妃说道。
柳妃看向苏业，脸上勉强的笑容：“苏先生客气了。”
“哎，我可不是客气，那个问你一个事情啊，柳小姐。”苏业看向柳妃笑着说道道。
“苏先生，您说。”柳妃轻柔的说道道。
“嗯，炒粉吗？”苏业看向柳妃笑着说道。
傅伟听到苏业的话，刚刚喝了一口茶，差点没喷出来，果然是泥腿子，你特么是个人啊。
这话你都能说出来的啊。
柳妃直接呆滞住了，看向苏业，有些不可置信，这人长得这么帅，怎么感觉是个人渣啊？
“开个玩笑，这不是看柳小姐有点不高兴嘛，活跃一下气氛，我这人最见不得美女伤心了。”苏业笑着说道。
话是这么说，手却不由自主的导航到了大腿上，嗯，柳妃的大腿。
柳妃身躯一僵！！
感受着自己大腿上那不老实的手，这还是第一次这么接触异性，亦或者说被异性抚摸。
不过一种异样的感觉在柳妃的心间升起。
这种感觉，柳妃也不知道为什么。
苏业的魅魔被动发动了。（色欲神性！）
“苏先生。”傅伟的声音响起。
“说。”苏业带着一丝不爽的说道。

In the box.
Su ye looked at the girl sitting inside with a strange look in his eyes.
Concubine Liu!
She is a national idol of the entire empire. In the words of the entertainment industry, if nothing happens to her, other female stars will never be able to stand out in their entire lives.
It's just so outrageous.
But now he is sitting obediently in the box, with a trace of sadness on his delicate face, but he has to smile.
His bright eyes in the past were now a bit gray.
Before this, she was well taken care of, very good, and she has been praised to the heavens since her debut.
Until now.
She understood that no matter how famous or capable she was, she would just be like that in front of these powerful people.
The fact that she has people taking care of her is not because no one likes her, but because she is very expensive and valuable, and the company does not want her to depreciate. This is why her journey has been smooth.
After all, the entertainment industry is a place where everyone knows it, but there are not many clean ones. Unless someone from a rich and powerful family comes to play, that is another matter.
"Are you satisfied, Mr. Su?" Fu Wei said with a smile on his face.
This is an existence specially promoted by Jinqing Entertainment Media. It is still very clean. I don’t know how many people are watching, but Fu Wei knows it.
The most valuable thing about a woman is two words: clean! !
Although the words don't sound good, it is the fact, especially for a playboy like Su ye who has never played anything before.
Cleanliness is the most important thing, nothing else matters. After cultivating her for so long and paying so much, now it's Concubine Liu's turn to show her own value.
"Satisfied, very satisfied." Su ye smiled and sat directly in front of Concubine Liu.
Looking at Concubine Liu in front of her, with a smile of compromise on her delicate little face and an indelible sadness in her eyes, people can't help but feel affection for her.
"Miss Liu Concubine, I am your fan." Su ye said to Concubine Liu with a smile.
Concubine Liu looked at Su Ye with a forced smile on her face: "Mr. Su, you're welcome."
"Hey, I'm not being polite. Let me ask you something, Miss Liu." Su ye looked at Concubine Liu and said with a smile.
"Mr. Su, please tell me." Concubine Liu said softly.
"Well, stir-fried noodles?" Su ye looked at Concubine Liu and said with a smile.
When Fu Wei heard Su Ye's words, he just took a sip of tea and almost spit it out. It turned out to be muddy legs. You are such a human being.
You can say this.
Concubine Liu was stunned and looked at Su ye, a little in disbelief. This man was so handsome, why did he feel like a scumbag?
"Just kidding, isn't it because Miss Liu is a little unhappy? Let's liven up the atmosphere. I hate seeing beautiful women sad the most." Su Ye said with a smile.
As she said this, her hand involuntarily moved to her thigh, well, Concubine Liu's thigh.
Concubine Liu's body froze! !
Feeling the dishonest hand on her thigh, this was the first time she had been in contact with the opposite sex, or was touched by the opposite sex.
However, a strange feeling arose in Concubine Liu's heart.
Concubine Liu didn't know why she felt this way.
Su ye's succubus was passively activated. (The divinity of lust!)
"Mr. Su." Fu Wei's voice sounded.
"Say." Su ye said with a hint of displeasure.
